title: A1 calibration slice — canonical introductions review
description: The reviewer-facing overlay for the canonical 20-entry introductions slice in content/curriculum/A1.json. Curriculum owns entry order and prerequisites; this file adds review sections, teaching objectives, patterns and explicit recycling.

units.title: Introduce yourself
units.goal: Name the speaker and listener, introduce one person or thing, and form the smallest identity statements.

entries.objective: Refer to yourself as the speaker.
Address the listener directly.
Introduce one non-specific countable person or thing.
Build basic identity, description and location statements.
Mark something as belonging to the speaker.

units.title: Ask and identify
units.goal: Exchange a name and identify a nearby person or thing.

entries.objective: Mark something as belonging to the listener.
Identify a person by name.
Ask for basic identity or information.
Point to or identify a nearby person or thing.
Refer to one male person already identified.

units.title: Ask about people and places
units.goal: Ask who someone is, ask about origin or location, and name a basic place of study.

entries.objective: Ask for the identity of a person.
Ask about a basic location or origin.
Express a person's place of origin.
Locate someone or something inside a place or area.
Identify the basic place or institution where someone studies.

units.title: Share personal details
units.goal: Say where you live, mention close people, and ask how someone is.

entries.objective: Refer to a city as a place where someone can be or live.
Say where a person has their home.
Refer to a person's close family as a group.
Refer to a person someone knows and likes.
Ask about condition or wellbeing in a basic exchange.
